subject: Re: Enquiry — does D153/1–8 contain a c.1875–1880 Llandough-juxta-Penarth instrument?
source: Original email in the family's Gmail (read-only export); contact details redacted.
text:
Dear Louise Hunt,

Thank you for your email of 6 October 2026 (ref 2026/4274).

I note that D153/1–8 is held at the National Library of Wales and will pursue that route with them. I also note your clarification that DRA/11/120 (formerly D/DRa 11/120) relates to Elder’s Navigation Colliery, Maesteg, and is not relevant to Great House Farm / Ty Mawr, Llandough-juxta-Penarth.

The reference originated from earlier research notes; I will not pursue it further with Glamorgan Archives.

Thank you for the clear direction.

Yours faithfully,
Sion Buckler (Ret'd Sergeant)
Royal Signals Cyber/Electronic Warfare Professional and Life Member
